resources.string: During spoken CarPlay guidance, volume keys adjust navigation volume. DiPlay mode requires wheel key accessibility permission and a separate legacy stream; automatic or media routing passes through. Calls, map zoom and joystick keep priority.
Let the car control navigation audio (experimental)

Use ECARX navigation focus and let the car lower music. DiPlay adds no extra attenuation. Turn off if music becomes too quiet: playback and ducking then use the existing DiPlay behavior. Applies at the next CarPlay connection.
Allow the wheel key accessibility service in Android settings, or use Enable wheel key service.
